scope: VIX and VIXW index options only; never options on VX futures or volatility ETF/ETN options

instrument.settlement_method: AM special opening quotation; not closing spot VIX
instrument.reference_price: observed VX futures contract with exactly matching settlement date; this is a pricing reference, not the legal underlying or deliverable

calendar.current_last_trading_rule: Exchange business day preceding official settlement date, 16:00 CT on a normal full session; explicit holiday/exception schedule overrides
calendar.future_announcement_gate: Do not enable the Cboe technical FAQ expiration-day 09:00 ET cutoff while its effective date is TBD
calendar.normal_expiry: Wednesday identified explicitly by the listed product; exchange holidays on that Wednesday or Friday 30 days later can shift it to the preceding business day
calendar.monthly_vs_weekly: Keep explicit root/listing classification; monthly and weekly may use different SPX settlement constituent expirations
calendar.authoritative_dates: Official Cboe calendar plus explicit listed contract metadata must agree; no rule-only calendar inference, weekday-only substitution, unsupported year or unexplained exceptional date
calendar.paper_session_scope: Regular trading hours only; extended hours are not executable without a separately registered rule
calendar.new_entry_deadline: Before the mandatory exit session and with 7-21 calendar DTE; official expiry in current local calendar month
calendar.mandatory_exit: No later than the regular close of the earlier of the tenth following regular session, the regular session preceding the contract last trading date, or the penultimate regular session of the local calendar month
calendar.expiry_handling: Close before expiry. If a valid disposal bid is absent, hold the entire shared ledger; do not fabricate settlement, write off, reset the month or release risk budget
calendar.settlement_extension: A later separately tested extension may post official VRO cash on its verified publication/availability timestamp, with cash availability on the following exchange business day. It must never replace VRO with spot VIX or VX last/settlement without verified equivalence

signals.bar_frequency: Official regular-session daily closing index observations
signals.lookback_convention: All lookbacks exclude the current observation; require consecutive valid exchange sessions and positive finite values; do not forward-fill missing observations
signals.availability: A completed close is usable only after actual source availability. A forward paper fill requires a later executable quote observed more than 60 seconds after the durable decision

vix_shock_breakout_call_v1.hypothesis: A newly confirmed volatility shock may continue enough to overcome an option's spread, fees and time decay; this is unproven

vix_spike_fade_put_v1.entry_condition: VIX[t-1] >= 25 AND VIX[t] <= 0.90 * VIX[t-1] AND VIX[t] < mean(VIX[t-5:t])
vix_spike_fade_put_v1.hypothesis: A confirmed reversal after elevated volatility may continue; spot mean reversion need not produce a profitable put

requirements: Cboe VIX9D daily CLOSE from identical sessions and available by decision
vix_short_term_stress_call_v1.entry_condition: VIX9D[t] / VIX[t] > 1.05 AND all(VIX9D[i] / VIX[i] <= 1.00 for i in t-5:t)
vix_short_term_stress_call_v1.hypothesis: A sudden short-horizon implied-volatility inversion may identify continued stress; the index ratio is not a VX futures spread
vix_short_term_stress_call_v1.missing_data: Blocked without both dated official index series; never substitute VIX3M or interpolate a VX futures curve

contracts_and_execution.position: At most one fully paid long call OR put, one contract, across AAPL and every other enrolled symbol in one shared ledger
contracts_and_execution.contract_filters: Verified VIX/VIXW metadata; 7-21 calendar DTE, expiry current month; 5%-25% out of the money relative to the actual exactly matched-expiry VX reference: call K/F-1 or put 1-K/F; ask >= 0.10; all-in debit <=125.00
contracts_and_execution.deterministic_selection: Eligible contract nearest 14 calendar DTE, then nearest 10% forward OTM, then lexicographic provider contract ID; never sort by realized profit
contracts_and_execution.reference_gate: Require a positive actual exactly matched-expiry VX observation and its availability, from the same eligible decision snapshot; missing, stale or synthetic reference blocks entry. No spot-as-forward, continuous rolled future or model-price substitute
contracts_and_execution.quote_gate: Positive uncrossed bid/ask; spread <=25% of midpoint; executable side size >=1; bounded freshness and exact session/time provenance. EOD quotes received the next day are not next-day executable quotes
contracts_and_execution.entry: Buy ask at the next eligible regular-session quote observed more than 60 seconds after durable decision and available by the execution clock; no same-snapshot fill
contracts_and_execution.exit: Observe bid >=5 times entry ask or bid <=0.5 times entry ask; fill only at a later eligible bid. A precommitted mandatory exit may fill on its eligible disposal session without waiting for a new threshold signal
contracts_and_execution.fee_assumption_per_side: 0.65 USD; a modeling assumption, not a quote of Cboe/broker index-option transaction fees
contracts_and_execution.fee_stress: Repeat counterfactual calculations at 1.30 USD per side with the same 125 entry and 500 monthly allowances; do not silently alter active paper fees
contracts_and_execution.shared_selector: Append registered VIX hypotheses after existing registered equity strategies in an explicitly versioned cross-symbol rotation. Never replace the owner account, reset the existing cursor, retrospectively seed a new VIX account or add funding
contracts_and_execution.activation: No automatic migration from this research registration. A new integrated version must preserve and verify existing cash, contributions, committed budget, holds, positions, pending decisions, histories and activation cutoff

risk_budget.monthly_shared_maximum: 500.00 USD premium plus entry fees plus reserved exit fees across all symbols and strategies
risk_budget.month_boundary: Verified flat only; unresolved or uncertain exposure holds all symbols and prevents rollover
risk_budget.cap_meaning: Modeled loss from each verified flat month start excluding deposits; not guaranteed intramonth peak-to-trough drawdown, liquidity or real execution

evaluation.outcome_gate: Actual timestamped contract bid/ask history with accepted provenance, calendar and reference data is required for option P&L. Spot index response alone is a signal study, never an option backtest
evaluation.point_in_time: Separate observed, provider available and retrieved timestamps. An archive downloaded now is not live evidence available earlier. Historical availability or size assumptions must be explicit and disqualify forward-execution claims
evaluation.sample: Use every eligible session in the accepted data overlap; publish start/end, missing sessions, listed-contract coverage and all rejected entry/exit reasons
evaluation.split: Chronological first70% / final30% session split for descriptive out-of-sample reporting; no parameter tuning, no winner substitution and no claimed untouched historical holdout after this design is published
report: gross and net realized P&L excluding deposits
unrealized marks and unresolved positions separately
evaluation.qualification: No winning-strategy or profitable execution claim from small samples, retrospective spot moves, synthetic tests or full-sample ranking. Forward paper enrollment requires independently tested instrument/account migration, actual fresh quotes and references, official calendar and preserved shared cap
